    Description

    Who We Are

    Neya Systems LLC., a subsidiary of Applied Research Associates (ARA) is a recognized leader in off-road autonomy and mission orchestration software, delivering cutting-edge robotic solutions for defense, commercial, and industrial applications. As a wholly owned subsidiary of ARA, we develop ruggedized, field-proven platforms designed to solve complex challenges in unstructured environments through innovative autonomous and robotic technologies.

    Who We're Looking For

    We are seeking an experienced Senior Mechanical Engineer to lead the design, development, integration, and testing of advanced robotic and autonomous systems. The ideal candidate combines strong mechanical engineering fundamentals with demonstrated experience developing complex electro-mechanical systems, robotic tooling, automation equipment, and custom mechanical assemblies from concept through deployment.

    This role is ideal for an engineer who thrives in a fast-paced, hands-on environment, enjoys solving challenging technical problems, and can independently lead mechanical development efforts while collaborating across software, electrical, systems, and manufacturing disciplines.

    What You'll Be Doing

    Technical Leadership

    • Lead the mechanical design and integration of complex robotic platforms, automation systems, sensor payloads, and vehicle subsystems.
    • Develop mechanical architectures and conduct trade studies evaluating performance, cost, manufacturability, reliability, and schedule impacts.
    • Independently plan and execute engineering efforts with minimal supervision while serving as a technical resource to project teams.
    • Mentor junior engineers and provide guidance on engineering best practices, design reviews, and problem resolution.

    Product Development & Design

    • Design electro-mechanical assemblies, robotic tooling, end effectors, fixtures, test equipment, housings, brackets, and custom mechanisms using SolidWorks.
    • Create detailed manufacturing drawings, BOMs, and release packages utilizing GD&T and Design for Manufacturability (DFM) principles.
    • Collaborate with software, electrical, and systems engineering teams to integrate mechanical solutions into complete robotic systems.
    • Support supplier interactions, fabrication efforts, and prototype builds to rapidly mature designs.

    Analysis, Testing & Validation

    • Perform structural, thermal, and dynamic analyses using engineering calculations and simulation tools to evaluate design performance.
    • Develop and execute test plans, qualification procedures, and verification activities for mechanical and integrated robotic systems.
    • Design and implement test fixtures and validation methods to improve system performance and reliability.
    • Support environmental, functional, and field testing activities and document results through technical reports and presentations.

    Customer & Business Support

    • Interface directly with customers, suppliers, and program stakeholders to define requirements and communicate technical solutions.
    • Support proposal development, concept generation, feasibility studies, and technical reviews.
    • Participate in occasional travel (approximately 10% or less) to support customer meetings, demonstrations, and field activities.

    What You'll Bring

    Education

    • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electro-Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a closely related engineering discipline required.
    • Master's degree preferred.

    Experience

    • 7+ years of progressive mechanical engineering experience developing complex electro-mechanical systems, robotics, automation equipment, autonomous platforms, or related technologies.
    • Demonstrated experience leading projects from concept development through manufacturing, integration, testing, and deployment.
    • Experience working within multidisciplinary engineering teams and collaborating across technical functions.

    Technical Expertise

    • Advanced proficiency with SolidWorks and PDM/PLM environments.
    • Strong understanding of GD&T, tolerance analysis, DFMA principles, manufacturing processes, and material selection.
    • Experience designing robotic tooling, end effectors, automation equipment, fixtures, and electro-mechanical assemblies.
    • Experience supporting hands-on prototyping, fabrication, assembly, and system integration.
    • Ability to independently solve complex technical problems and make sound engineering decisions while balancing cost, performance, schedule, and risk.

    Communication & Leadership

    • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
    • Demonstrated ability to lead technical efforts and influence engineering direction.
    • Experience mentoring engineers and providing technical guidance to project teams.

    Work Authorization

    • U.S. Citizenship or permanent residency required due to defense contracting requirements.

    How You'll Stand Out

    • Experience designing robotic end effectors, grippers, EOATs, or custom automation systems.
    • Experience with industrial robotics, robotic cell design, and automated material handling systems.
    • Familiarity with machine safety standards, risk assessments, and industrial automation best practices.
    • Hands-on experience with rapid prototyping, additive manufacturing, sheet metal design, and weldments.
    • Experience with FEA, structural analysis, or thermal analysis tools.
    • Background developing standardized products, reducing manufacturing costs, and improving engineering processes.
    • Working knowledge of Python, C++, or other scripting languages used for engineering analysis and automation.

    What We Offer

    • Comprehensive health, vision, and dental insurance plans
    • Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and Health Savings Account (HSA) options
    • Competitive 401(k) retirement plan with company matching
    • Generous Paid Time Off (PTO) package, including company holidays
    • Professional development support and continuous learning opportunities
    • Travel compensation policies for field deployment activities

    Neya Systems LLC., is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

    Definition of Disability

    As a general matter, "disability" for legal purposes means a physical or mental impairment that substantially limits one or more major life activities, or having a record of such an impairment, or being regarded as having such an impairment.

    Major life activities includes things like caring for oneself, performing manual tasks, seeing, hearing, eating, sleeping, walking, standing, lifting, bending, speaking, breathing, learning, reading, concentrating, thinking, communicating, working, and the operation of a major bodily function (like the immune system, normal cell growth, or digestive, bowel, bladder, neurological, brain, respiratory, circulatory, endocrine and/or reproductive functions). An impairment that is episodic or in remission is a disability if it would substantially limit a major life activity when active.

    The determination of whether an impairment substantially limits a major life activity is made without regard to the ameliorative effects of mitigating measures (such as medication, medical supplies, equipment, or appliances, some low-vision devices (see below), prosthetics including limbs and devices, hearing aids and cochlear implants or other implantable hearing devices, mobility devices, oxygen therapy equipment and supplies; use of assistive technology, reasonable accommodations or auxiliary aids or services, or learned behavioral or adaptive neurological modifications). Provided, however, that the mitigating impact of ordinary eyeglasses or contact lenses shall be considered in determining whether an impairment substantially limits a major life activity. Alcohol or drug addiction are generally considered disabilities, however: the current use of drugs or alcohol does not qualify as a disability if it prevents the individual from performing the duties of the job or if their employment would, due to the drug or alcohol use, constitute a direct threat to property or the safety of others.
